evidence.quote: Courses are taught in German and English language.
As a state university in Germany´s federal state of Hesse, Fulda University of Applied Sciences does not charge any tuition fees.
With foreign educational qualifications: 1 May to 30 September

notes: The tuition fee is 0 EUR per year, as the university is state-funded and charges no tuition fees for any student, but a semester contribution of around 400 EUR is charged separately. The application deadline for foreign educational qualifications is 1 May to 30 September for the winter semester and 1 November to 31 March for the summer semester, with no year stated, so it is expressed as a recurring deadline. The German C1 requirement uses DSH-2 or equivalent, and the English B1 requirement accepts specific tests such as TOEFL and IELTS. The application channel is via uni-assist as stated on the DAAD page.

evidence.quote: English language skills B1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Cambridge English Qualifications: A2 Key TOEIC: 550 Reading: 275 Listening: 275 Speaking: 120 Writing: 120 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 43 Reading: 4 Listening: 9 Speaking: 16 Writing: 13 IELTS Academic: 4
